name: Ocean West Boutique Hotel
brand_truth: Ten gem-named rooms on a ridge 70 ft up, between Lake Killarney and the Atlantic, five minutes from the airport.

design.hero_pattern: section-elevation-split (ridge drawing with clickable gem windows)
design.signature: Elevation drawing of the hotel on its 70 ft ridge between lake and ocean; each of the 10 windows is a clickable gem room that opens its real photo and details

current_site_findings: Same keyword-stuffed title on every page.
Headings are images inside tables, unreadable to Google and phones.
No address or phone on the homepage.
Ten gem rooms shown as tiny thumbnails with no comparison.
The 70 ft ridge between lake and ocean is a single sentence.
pitch_line: You have ten rooms named after gems on a ridge between a lake and the ocean; this concept lets a guest tap the Diamond Room's window and book it, instead of squinting at thumbnails in a 2010 table layout.
assumptions: Ridge drawing positions rooms by floor only; exact window layout is illustrative
notes: No street number published; address shown as West Bay St, Nassau with the hotel's own map pin (25.069827,-77.443689). Booking CTA links to their real innRoad engine. Tripadvisor/HotelsCombined badges they display were not used (avoid rating claims). Gem colour swatches are decorative. Scorecard: 1:4 2:4 3:4 4:5 5:4 6:4 7:5 8:4 9:4 10:5 11:5.
